trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives at 10:30 PM
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 10:30 PM. Take the Ramada free theme park shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney World park tickets and plans for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or airport food before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport layover
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour Denny's (~1 mile from hotel) or pick up snacks at a nearby Walmart Neighborhood Market on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy to stock up for the week and save money on breakfasts

day_by_day.notes: Pro tip: Stop at Walmart or Publix near the hotel tonight or first thing tomorrow morning to stock up on breakfast items, snacks, and water bottles. Bringing your own food and drinks into Disney parks (no glass containers or alcohol) can save $50-100+ per day for a family. Get a good night's rest — big park days ahead!

day_by_day.morning: Early start! Wake up by 7:00 AM and eat a quick breakfast from your hotel room supplies. Take the Ramada's free theme park shuttle to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then rush to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using the Lightning Lane if budget allows, or use the free virtual queue. Explore Cinderella Castle and Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise) and Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion). Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat hours (2–4 PM) — find air-conditioned shows like the Hall of Presidents or Mickey's PhilharMagic to rest your feet. Ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Magic Kingdom fireworks show 'Disney Enchantment' (typically at 9:00 PM — check the app for exact time). This is a must-see and completely included with park admission. Take the free shuttle back to the hotel afterward.

meals.breakfast: DIY breakfast at hotel room — cereal, fruit, granola bars purchased from Walmart
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — one of Magic Kingdom's most budget-friendly quick-service spots. Try the lobster roll or chicken sandwich combo (~$14-16 per person). Less crowded than Central Plaza options.
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — large portions, affordable quick-service meals (~$12-15 per person). Or bring in your own packed sandwiches and snacks to save significantly.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the most popular park — arriving at rope drop is essential. Download the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle (free water is available at any quick-service counter). Sunscreen is a must in June — Florida heat is intense. Park tickets should be purchased in advance online for best pricing.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to EPCOT, arriving at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (use the virtual queue — join at exactly 7:00 AM on the app the morning of). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE. Explore the stunning new World Nature area and ride Soarin' Around the World — arrive early to avoid long waits.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the World Showcase — 11 country pavilions representing cultures from around the globe. This is completely free to walk through with park admission. Sample affordable international street food snacks as you stroll. Visit the American Adventure attraction (free, air-conditioned, and educational). Check the app for free live cultural performances and entertainment throughout the World Showcase.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Luminous The Symphony of Us' (check current show schedule on the app). The fireworks over World Showcase Lagoon are breathtaking and included with admission. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — yogurt, fruit, toast or instant oatmeal
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best quick-service values with fresh, varied options (~$12-15 per person). Sandwiches, grain bowls, and rotisserie chicken available.
meals.dinner: World Showcase food stalls — budget $10-15 per person for a mix of international snacks and small plates from countries like Morocco, China, or Mexico. This is a fun, affordable way to 'eat around the world' without sit-down restaurant prices.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear very comfortable shoes. The World Showcase alone is a 1.3-mile loop. June is EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival season — there may be additional food booths with small-plate options for $5-9 each, which is a great budget-friendly way to sample diverse cuisines. Stay hydrated — free water cups are available at any quick-service location.

day_by_day.morning: Rest day morning — sleep in until 8:00-9:00 AM. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the hotel. Take the free shuttle or a short drive to Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Explore the shops, browse the massive World of Disney store, and enjoy the lively atmosphere along the waterfront. No park ticket required!
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Disney Springs. Check out the LEGO Store with its impressive outdoor sculptures, visit the free NBA Experience lobby area, and browse the unique boutique shops. If budget allows, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater (~$15-18 per ticket) for a cool, air-conditioned break during the hottest part of the day. Alternatively, head back to the hotel for a pool break — the Ramada has a pool, perfect for cooling off.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Disney Springs for dinner and evening entertainment. Enjoy the free live music performances at various outdoor stages throughout the complex. Window shop and people-watch along the waterfront. Take the free shuttle back to the hotel by 9:00-10:00 PM.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — eggs, toast, fruit, coffee
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own personal pizzas for ~$10-13. Quick, filling, and budget-friendly.
meals.dinner: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — Guy Fieri's fast-casual chicken tender restaurant with 22 dipping sauces. Meals run ~$12-16 per person and portions are generous. Or try The Polite Pig for BBQ at slightly higher prices (~$16-20) but excellent value for a sit-down experience.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter and park — no theme park ticket needed. This is a great budget recovery day. Use this day to do laundry at the hotel if needed, restock snacks at a nearby grocery store, and charge all your devices. Rest your feet for the remaining park days ahead. Check the Disney Springs entertainment schedule online for free live performances.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios, arriving at rope drop (~9:00 AM). This park requires strategic planning. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. The entire land is stunning to explore even while waiting.
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then explore the classic Hollywood Studios attractions: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith (thrill rides — skip if traveling with very young children). Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular — a free, incredible live show included with admission.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime spectacular — an outdoor amphitheater show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, water screens, and fireworks. Check the app for show times (usually 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 30-45 minutes early for good seating. This is one of Disney's best free included shows. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — granola bars, fruit, instant coffee
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' most affordable quick-service spots. Grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and lunch box tarts for ~$10-14 per person. Arrive early or late to avoid long lines.
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — a large, air-conditioned quick-service restaurant with burgers, sandwiches, and international options for ~$12-16 per person. Good value and rarely as crowded as other Hollywood Studios dining spots.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is the most 'Lightning Lane heavy' park — Rise of the Resistance and Slinky Dog Dash have the longest waits. Rope drop strategy is critical here. The Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land is worth spending significant time in even without riding — the theming and atmosphere are extraordinary. Check the My Disney Experience app constantly for wait time fluctuations throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Disney's Animal Kingdom, arriving at rope drop (~8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom often opens earlier than other parks). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride with the longest waits — go first thing). Then ride Na'vi River Journey. The bioluminescent theming of Pandora is stunning even during daylight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and ride Kilimanjaro Safaris — the best time is morning or late afternoon when animals are most active, but afternoon works well too. Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail (free, self-guided wildlife trail). Visit Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — great for the June heat!). Explore DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Rivers of Light' or the Tree of Life Awakenings — the Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark, and it's completely free with admission. Enjoy the magical atmosphere of the park at dusk. Take the hotel shuttle back by 9:00-10:00 PM.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — the biggest meal of the day to fuel up before the park
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of Disney World's best quick-service restaurants with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating. Ribs, chicken, and pulled pork platters for ~$14-18 per person. Excellent value.
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — Avatar-themed quick-service with healthy grain bowls, protein options, and unique beverages for ~$14-17 per person. One of Disney World's most creative and satisfying quick-service meals.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. The park is heavily outdoor-focused, so sunscreen and hydration are especially important. Kali River Rapids will soak you — bring a change of clothes or wear quick-dry clothing. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks (around 8-9 PM), so plan accordingly. This is a great day to use any remaining Lightning Lane budget.

day_by_day.morning: Check out of the Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Store luggage at the hotel front desk if your flight is later in the day. Take one final victory lap — return to your favorite park for a few hours, or revisit Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping. Alternatively, explore the International Drive area near the hotel for budget souvenir shops (much cheaper than inside Disney parks — same merchandise at 50-70% less).
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the nearby International Drive area or Old Town Kissimmee for affordable souvenir shopping. Browse the many discount souvenir shops along US-192 (W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy) near the hotel for the best prices on Disney merchandise, t-shirts, and gifts. Pick up luggage from the hotel and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport (MCO) — budget rideshare ~$25-35, or Mears Connect shuttle ~$16-21 per person.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at least 2 hours before your flight. Reflect on an incredible week at Disney World! Browse airport shops for any final souvenirs. Enjoy a sit-down meal at the airport before your flight home.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel room breakfast — use up remaining groceries and snacks purchased earlier in the week
meals.lunch: International Drive area — Shake Shack, Chipotle, or local Cuban restaurants along US-192 offer great value (~$10-15 per person). Or grab a final Disney Springs meal if returning there.
meals.dinner: Orlando International Airport — Chili's To Go, Burger Fi, or Cask & Larder in the terminal. Budget $15-20 per person for airport dining.

day_by_day.notes: Budget tip recap for the week: Bringing your own breakfast foods and snacks saved approximately $200-400 for a family of four. Using the free hotel shuttle saved $100+ in transportation costs. Eating at quick-service restaurants instead of table-service saved another $200-300. Total estimated savings from budget strategies: $500-700+ compared to a non-budget Disney trip. Souvenir shops on US-192 near the hotel offer Disney merchandise at 40-70% less than in-park prices — stock up here rather than inside the parks. Safe travels!

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle or a rideshare to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review the week's park plans. Pick up any essentials at a nearby 24-hour Walmart or Walgreens on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the hotel vending area or a nearby fast-casual spot like Denny's (open 24 hrs, ~1 mile from hotel) on arrival

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light – it's purely a travel and check-in day. Set alarms early for Day 2. Download the My Disney Experience app and link your park tickets tonight if you haven't already. Purchase park tickets in advance online to save time and money.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Use the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~7:30–8:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then hit Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight using Lightning Lane if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom – Visit Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Enjoy the afternoon parade on Main Street U.S.A. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed (shuttle runs regularly) to rest during peak heat hours (2–4 PM), then return for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically ~9:00 PM). Stroll Main Street U.S.A. for souvenir shopping before park close.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel or a nearby McDonald's before the shuttle. Alternatively, grab a pastry and coffee at Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and sandwiches (~$15–$20/person)
meals.dinner: Pinocchio Village Haus near Fantasyland – pasta, flatbreads, and Italian-American dishes with a view of 'it's a small world' (~$15–$22/person)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance for Magic Kingdom to skip lines on top attractions. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and a light rain poncho. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (~90°F) with frequent afternoon thunderstorms.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (opens ~9:00 AM). Start in Future World/World Discovery with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track. Then head to World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the 11 country pavilions around World Showcase Lagoon. Sample authentic cuisines and snacks from Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, Japan, Morocco, France, the UK, and Canada. Visit the Norway pavilion for Frozen Ever After ride. Browse artisan shops and cultural exhibits in each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's LUMINOUS The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (typically ~9:00 PM). Enjoy a sit-down dinner at one of the World Showcase restaurants before the show.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion – fresh, affordable breakfast options like eggs, pastries, and smoothies (~$10–$14/person)
meals.lunch: Graze through World Showcase – try a School Bread from Norway (~$6), a crepe from France (~$8), and a taco from Mexico (~$10). Budget ~$20–$25 for a satisfying food tour lunch.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan pavilion – hibachi-style teppanyaki dining, a fun and memorable mid-range experience (~$30–$40/person). Reserve via My Disney Experience app in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is best enjoyed at a leisurely pace. The World Showcase is a cultural highlight and perfect for families. If the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival is running in June, take full advantage of the extra food booths. Comfortable walking shoes are essential as EPCOT is very large.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge in Batuu. Book a time slot for Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first thing. If budget allows, reserve Savi's Workshop (custom lightsaber, ~$249.99) or Droid Depot (~$119.99) – book weeks in advance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive attractions – use Lightning Lane). Explore the Oga's Cantina for themed drinks. Then head to other Hollywood Studios highlights: Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land, Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check schedule, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM). This spectacular water, fire, and projection show is a Hollywood Studios highlight and free with park admission.

meals.breakfast: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land – fun counter-service breakfast with toasted cheese sandwiches and breakfast bowls (~$10–$14/person)
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge – try the Ronto Wrap with roasted pork and grilled sausage, a fan favorite (~$14–$16/person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – a unique mid-range table-service experience where you dine in retro cars watching classic sci-fi movie clips (~$20–$35/person). Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks – arrive at rope drop. Lightning Lane is highly recommended for Rise of the Resistance and Slinky Dog Dash. If Savi's Workshop is on your list, book it the moment reservations open (60 days in advance). Wear Star Wars or Disney-themed attire for extra fun.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage – Take the hotel shuttle for rope drop (~8:00 AM, Animal Kingdom opens early). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride). Virtual queue or Lightning Lane is essential – join as soon as the park opens.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board the Kilimanjaro Safari in Africa to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and hippos in a realistic savanna setting (~20-minute open-air vehicle tour). Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride and Primeval Whirl.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings – a stunning projection show on the iconic Tree of Life that runs after dark at intervals. Explore Discovery Island and Asia before heading back to the hotel for a relaxed evening. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8:00–9:00 PM).

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel or Starbucks near the park entrance before rope drop
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, protein options, and unique Pandoran desserts (~$15–$20/person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – Asian-fusion table service with dishes like Mandarin chicken, lo mein, and ahi tuna (~$20–$35/person). Reserve in advance, or use the Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes for a budget-friendly counter-service version.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. The park can get extremely hot by midday – plan a rest break or visit the Na'vi River Journey (a calmer boat ride through Pandora) during peak heat. Bring insect repellent for outdoor trails.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take the hotel's free shuttle to Disney Springs (no park ticket required). Explore the vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), LEGO Store, and unique boutiques. Watch free street performers and live music acts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy free entertainment at Disney Springs – catch live music at the Marketplace Stage or West Side. Visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment (mid-range activity, ~$20–$25/person). Browse the Art of Disney gallery. If budget allows, try the Aerophile hot air balloon tethered ride for aerial views (~$25/person).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a leisurely dinner at Disney Springs and catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy more live entertainment. Return to the hotel at a relaxed pace for an early night before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: The Polite Pig – a Disney Springs gem with smoked meats, biscuits, and Southern-style breakfast items (~$12–$16/person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger – gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a fun, casual setting (~$14–$18/person)
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE – upscale-casual waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and pasta. A mid-range splurge for the family (~$30–$50/person). Alternatively, Blaze Pizza or Chicken Guy! for a more budget-friendly dinner (~$12–$16/person).

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to save on park ticket costs while still enjoying the Disney atmosphere. Saturday can be busy – arrive early for parking or use the hotel shuttle. This is a great day to purchase any remaining souvenirs at competitive prices. Many Disney Springs restaurants accept walk-ins.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park or revisit Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any missed attractions. Alternatively, spend a relaxed morning at the hotel pool, pack luggage, and check out. If returning to a park, use the hotel shuttle one last time and focus on 2–3 must-do rides or experiences you want to experience again.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head back to the hotel by early afternoon to collect luggage and check out. Depending on your flight time, explore the nearby International Drive area for last-minute shopping at Orlando Premium Outlets (~10 minutes away) or visit a local attraction like Ripley's Believe It or Not! or WonderWorks on I-Drive.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in and security. Reflect on an incredible week at Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a final Disney park breakfast if visiting – try Be Our Guest Restaurant in Magic Kingdom for a themed French-inspired breakfast (reserve in advance, ~$15–$25/person)
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal inside the park or a casual lunch on International Drive – Shake Shack or Tijuana Flats for affordable, satisfying options (~$12–$18/person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport – grab a meal at one of the terminal restaurants before your flight

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange luggage storage if needed for a late flight. Return any rental equipment or park gear. Back up all your Disney photos before heading home. Consider purchasing a Disney PhotoPass Memory Maker package to download all professional park photos taken during the trip.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Start your morning with a Kilimanjaro Safari to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos in a realistic savanna setting. Then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage ride. Explore the Pandora World of Avatar at dusk when the bioluminescent landscape glows beautifully.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora & Africa Sections, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight UA arrives at 22:30. No morning or afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take a pre-arranged private car transfer (recommended over shuttle given late arrival) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Order a late-night room service spread or grab a quick bite at the hotel's on-site dining option to wind down after travel.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport.
meals.dinner: Late-night room service or hotel restaurant upon arrival – opt for a light meal such as a club sandwich, soup, or a charcuterie board to avoid heavy eating before bed.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book a private luxury car transfer (e.g., Mears Connect Black Car or a local limo service) in advance to ensure a smooth, comfortable arrival at 22:30. Confirm check-in details with the hotel ahead of time for a seamless late-night arrival. Lay out park tickets, MagicBands, and the next day's essentials before sleeping to maximize efficiency tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Begin with an early rope-drop entry (park opens at 9:00 AM; aim to arrive by 8:30 AM via the hotel's free theme park shuttle). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and TRON Lightcycle / Run before crowds build. Use Disney's Lightning Lane Premier Pass (purchased in advance) to skip queues on top-tier attractions. Follow up with Pirates of the Caribbean and the Haunted Mansion in the late morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom – After lunch, experience Fantasyland highlights including Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Lightning Lane early), Peter Pan's Flight, and the Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade at 3:00 PM from a premium viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. Explore Liberty Square and Frontierland in the late afternoon, riding Big Thunder Mountain Railroad.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Magic Kingdom nighttime shows – Secure a prime spot on Main Street U.S.A. for the 'Disney Enchantment' nighttime spectacular and fireworks display over Cinderella Castle (typically at park close). This is a bucket-list Disney moment. Return to the hotel via the free shuttle after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom) – Book the prix-fixe breakfast in the Beast's enchanted castle for an immersive, premium dining experience. Reserve well in advance via the My Disney Experience app.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Skipper Canteen – Skipper Canteen offers a unique, story-driven atmosphere with globally inspired dishes; a great mid-tier premium lunch option inside the park.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table – Dine inside Cinderella Castle for a truly magical fine-dining experience with character meet-and-greets. Book 60 days in advance as this is one of Disney's most sought-after reservations. Enjoy dishes like pan-seared salmon, filet mignon, and decadent desserts.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Premier Pass the moment the park opens via the My Disney Experience app for maximum ride access. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a portable fan or cooling towel as June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+/32°C+). Stay hydrated throughout the day. The hotel's free shuttle typically runs on a schedule – confirm pickup/drop-off times the night before.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT, arriving at rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Begin in Future World / World Discovery with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane – secure your spot immediately upon entry) and Test Track. Then transition to World Nature to experience Soarin' Around the World with a Lightning Lane reservation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the World Showcase Lagoon, visiting all 11 country pavilions. Sample authentic cuisines and beverages from Mexico (margaritas at La Cava del Tequila), Japan (sushi and sake), France (crêpes and macarons), Morocco, and more. Enjoy the cultural entertainment, live music, and artisan demonstrations at each pavilion. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon – one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Watch from the waterfront promenade for the best views. Return to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion – A quick-service option with fresh, healthy options including grain bowls, pastries, and smoothies. Great for a light start before a full day.
meals.lunch: La Hacienda de San Angel (Mexico Pavilion) – Upscale Mexican cuisine with stunning views of World Showcase Lagoon. Enjoy dishes like slow-roasted pork, enchiladas, and fresh guacamole with premium margaritas.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (France Pavilion) – EPCOT's most acclaimed fine-dining restaurant, inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Enjoy classic French haute cuisine including foie gras, duck confit, and soufflé in an elegant, intimate setting. Reserve 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is best experienced at a leisurely pace – don't rush the World Showcase. La Cava del Tequila in the Mexico Pavilion often has a wait; arrive early or late in the afternoon. Consider purchasing the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival add-ons if visiting during that season (typically August–November, so not applicable in June, but the World Showcase always has excellent food options). Wear light, breathable clothing.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios for rope drop. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Begin with Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive and technologically advanced attractions – secure a Lightning Lane or boarding group immediately). Follow with Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on piloting experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Star Wars experience with a visit to Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (book in advance – $299.99 per lightsaber; a premium, unforgettable keepsake). Explore Oga's Cantina for exotic themed cocktails and snacks in an authentic Star Wars atmosphere (reservations required). Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios – ride Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land, Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Fantasmic!' – Hollywood Studios' iconic nighttime spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and stunning water/fire/projection effects in a 6,900-seat amphitheater. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for premium seating. Return to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) – Immersive Star Wars-themed quick-service dining with creative dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip. A fun, thematic start to the day.
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – A uniquely themed restaurant where you dine in vintage cars under a simulated starry night sky watching classic sci-fi movie clips. Enjoy burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes in a retro-cool atmosphere.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby – Hollywood Studios' premier fine-dining restaurant inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood hotspot. Enjoy signature dishes like the Cobb Salad (invented at the original Brown Derby), pan-seared grouper, and filet mignon. Excellent wine list and impeccable service.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations are essential and sell out weeks in advance – book via My Disney Experience app as soon as your trip is confirmed. Oga's Cantina also requires reservations and has a 45-minute time limit per visit. Lightning Lane Premier Pass is highly recommended for Hollywood Studios given the density of top-tier attractions. 'Fantasmic!' dining packages are available and include reserved seating – worth considering.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage – Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom for early entry (8:00 AM for resort guests). Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride – Lightning Lane is essential). The early morning light in Pandora is breathtaking. Follow with Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning boat ride through a bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari – the afternoon safari offers excellent wildlife viewing as animals are more active in the cooler parts of the day. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and more in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot afterward. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (bring a change of clothes or a poncho). Catch a performance of 'Festival of the Lion King' – one of Disney's best live shows.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Animal Kingdom's nighttime transformation – 'Rivers of Light' or the Tree of Life Awakenings (the iconic Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark). Enjoy the park's unique evening atmosphere before returning to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora) – A visually stunning quick-service restaurant inside Pandora with healthy, globally inspired bowls, wraps, and fresh juices. Perfect for a nutritious start before a big day.
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant – Animal Kingdom's flagship fine-dining restaurant, inspired by the travels of Disney's Imagineers. Enjoy artfully crafted dishes like whole-fried sustainable fish, braised short rib, and exotic desserts. The restaurant features stunning artwork and an intimate atmosphere.
meals.dinner: Jiko – The Cooking Place (Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge, nearby) – One of Walt Disney World's most celebrated restaurants, featuring African-inspired cuisine with a modern twist. Enjoy dishes like oak-grilled filet mignon, Durban-spiced chicken, and an award-winning South African wine list. A short rideshare or taxi from the hotel.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most physically expansive Disney park – wear your most comfortable walking shoes. The park is also the most nature-immersive, so insect repellent is recommended. Jiko at Animal Kingdom Lodge is not accessible via the hotel shuttle but is absolutely worth the short rideshare trip for a world-class dining experience. Book Tiffins and Jiko 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take the hotel shuttle to Disney Springs for a relaxed, crowd-free morning. Explore the vibrant waterfront shopping and entertainment district. Browse premium boutiques including World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), LEGO Store, and unique artisan shops. Visit the Marketplace Co-Op for exclusive Disney merchandise. Enjoy the street performers and live entertainment that begin mid-morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at Disney Springs with premium entertainment options – visit the NBA Experience for interactive basketball activities, or catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater. Explore the Art of Disney gallery for collectible artwork and limited-edition prints. Browse the Coca-Cola Store rooftop for panoramic views of Disney Springs. Consider a relaxing spa treatment at a nearby luxury spa (Senses – A Disney Spa at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort is a short rideshare away and offers world-class treatments).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a premium dinner and live entertainment at Disney Springs. Catch a performance at the House of Blues or enjoy the dueling pianos at Raglan Road Irish Pub. End the evening with a stroll along the waterfront, enjoying the illuminated fountains and ambient entertainment before returning to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: The Polite Pig (Disney Springs) – A beloved craft barbecue restaurant with a premium twist. Enjoy smoked brisket hash, breakfast bowls, and artisan coffee in a relaxed, stylish setting.
meals.lunch: Morimoto Asia – Celebrity chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Disney Springs restaurant. Enjoy Pan-Asian cuisine including Peking duck, dim sum, sushi, and signature cocktails in a stunning two-story space with dramatic décor.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando (Disney Springs) – A modern, upscale steakhouse with a lively atmosphere. Enjoy USDA prime cuts, fresh seafood, and an extensive wine and cocktail menu. One of the most premium dining experiences at Disney Springs with a chic, contemporary vibe.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and is a great lower-intensity day after four consecutive theme park days. It's an ideal opportunity to shop for premium Disney souvenirs and gifts. The Senses Spa at Grand Floridian requires advance booking – highly recommended for a mid-trip relaxation reset. Saturday can be busy at Disney Springs, so arrive early for the best parking/shuttle spots.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a favorite park or explore a new experience – Based on your family's preferences, use this final full day to revisit your favorite park or catch any attractions you missed. Alternatively, consider a morning visit to Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park for a refreshing, fun-filled morning (perfect for June heat). These premium water parks offer thrilling slides, lazy rivers, and wave pools – a wonderful contrast to the theme parks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Disney World experiences – If revisiting a theme park, use any remaining Lightning Lane credits and focus on must-do rides or shows you haven't experienced yet. Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the hotel pool, which is a great way to relax before departure. Use this time to pack, organize souvenirs, and prepare for checkout. Consider a final visit to a Disney Resort hotel lobby (Grand Floridian, Polynesian, or Contemporary) for a premium architectural and cultural experience – these are free to visit and stunning.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a world-class Orlando restaurant – Celebrate the end of a magical trip with a premium dinner. Return to the hotel for final packing and a good night's rest before departure. Arrange your departure transfer in advance.

meals.breakfast: Victoria & Albert's (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort) – If you can secure a reservation (book 60 days in advance; this is Walt Disney World's most exclusive restaurant), this AAA Five Diamond, Forbes Five-Star restaurant offers an extraordinary prix-fixe tasting menu with wine pairings. A once-in-a-lifetime dining experience. Alternatively, enjoy a premium breakfast at the hotel or a nearby café.
meals.lunch: Quick-service or casual dining at whichever park or location you choose for the morning – keep it light and flexible on the final day.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE (Disney Springs) – A nautical-themed upscale restaurant on the waterfront at Disney Springs. Enjoy fresh seafood, prime steaks, and craft cocktails with stunning views of the water. A perfect, celebratory farewell dinner with a relaxed yet premium atmosphere. Don't miss the Amphicar tours of the waterways.

day_by_day.notes: Victoria & Albert's is the crown jewel of Disney dining and requires reservations months in advance – if unavailable, Narcoossee's at the Grand Floridian (waterfront fine dining) is an excellent alternative. Confirm your departure transfer or shuttle to the airport the night before. Check out time at the Ramada is typically 11:00 AM – request a late checkout if your flight allows. Leave time to collect any final souvenirs at Disney Springs or the hotel gift shop. Tip: ship large souvenir purchases home via UPS/FedEx from Disney Springs to avoid luggage hassles.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
